languageTags.canonicalization: Use the platform locale implementation; preserve the user's requested tag for persistence.

unicode.normalization: NFC at text boundaries; preserve original source bytes and identifiers where normalization would change identity.

localeData.runtime: Use the newest compatible OS/ICU/CLDR data available; do not hand-maintain locale rules.

scripts: and any script supported by the installed Unicode/font stack

dynamicLanguagePacks.installation: explicit, local-first, versioned; never fetch or translate text automatically
dynamicLanguagePacks.missingTranslation: fallback without hiding the source message id

runtimeAdapter: The Qt 6 desktop adapter uses QLocale/QTranslator and Qt translation catalogs. DSP, sample data, preset serialization and audio-thread work remain locale-neutral; no translation lookup is allowed on the real-time audio thread.
